reviews.reason: harness.ts changed between 9fd2faa7 and C (K1.2). Top level: the type-only import gains OutcomeEnvelope and SubmissionGrant (erased), the own-array.ts import gains readAt (module already requested), and observer, submissionFor, unsafeDriver and outcomeFor are new function-valued declarations with no load-time effect. caller now adds controlScopes, a copy of scopes; the Kernel reads it only in requestTakeover, recoverExecution and reportProtocolFailure (coordinator.ts #requireControl), none of which this file calls. recordingDriver also records each submission grant through recordOwn and declares isSafeToReplace, which only takeover reads; the file still reads seen. Its one iterator-pollution window (line 888) creates no caller: author is built before it, so caller's new array spread never meets the hostile next; inherited-index traps cannot reach an own-array spread. The inputs and assertions of its literal-titled members are unchanged.
